# BotFn

> Discord and Slack bot integrations, issue linking, persistence, and operator controls.

- [Administration capability](/docs/admin) — Integrate BotFn operator resources with Super Console.
- [Discord bot](/docs/discord-bot) — Configure signed interactions, issue commands, and the Worker.
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Find the BotFn package or service that fits your integration.

- [Integration helpers](/docs/integrations) — Reuse Discord, Slack, GitHub, Linear, and schema helpers.
- [Operations and limits](/docs/operations-and-limits) — Deployment responsibilities and current feature boundaries.
- [Persistence service](/docs/persistence) — Store issue and Discord thread relationships through tRPC.

- [Configuration](/docs/reference/configuration) — Runtime bindings and deployment inputs by package.

- [Packages](/docs/reference/packages) — Current BotFn package map and entry points.
- [Slack receiver](/docs/slack-bot) — Verify Slack requests and understand the current event handler.
